note: Prototype weights and scoring configuration for Crop Ranking Engine. Weights reflect decision-support heuristic assumptions and are NOT scientifically calibrated agronomic or economic guarantees.

missing_market_data_policy.description: When market data is unavailable for a candidate crop, the combined score equals the normalized agronomic signal directly (no artificial penalty to market score 0). The ranking metadata explicitly marks market contribution as unavailable.

disclaimer: Crop ranking is a prototype decision-support tool. Crop model confidence reflects classifier probability rather than comprehensive agronomic suitability, and market scores reflect historical signals rather than guaranteed future prices or profitability.
